prompt.generated_prompt_string: Restore the attached cracked old portrait into a natural high-detail archival image. Preserve the exact adult face, identity, age presentation, hairstyle, expression, clothing neckline, crop, background, and original monochrome or verifiable tonal character. Repair cracks, tears, scratches, stains, fading, and damaged emulsion conservatively while recovering only verifiable detail. Do not add or remove people, alter the face or age, colorize without evidence, change clothing or background, smooth skin, invent missing facial features, or modernize the image beyond faithful restoration.
prompt.negative_prompt: identity change, face swap, age alteration, added person, removed person, invented facial features, colorization artifacts, changed clothing, changed background, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text alteration, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Original cracked portrait is mandatory. Restore only verified image information. Keep any unrecoverable region neutral rather than inventing new face, hair, clothing, or background data.
